Created by CARAMEL LONDON for ZARA

The second chapter of this collaboration is a harmony of two worlds. It embraces the rhythms and practices of a unique independent studio on a new scale, through slow making, thoughtful design and modern storytelling. The result is authentic, playful and effortless – a curated edit of the essentials for daily life, designed for longevity in the modern world.

STUDIO COLLECTION AW26
Wonderland

The collection’s directness is intentional. Attention to colour, proportion and detail keeps its simplicity from seeming conventional. The result is a wardrobe that feels straightforward, distinctive and instinctive: pure forms made particular through the way they are worn and experienced.

Photographer & Director: Ned Rogers  @nedrogers
Styling: #KarlTempler
Hair & Make Up: Sarah Edenborough @sarahedenborough
Set designer: Andy Hillman @andyhillmanstudio
Casting: @unit_c

#zarastudio #zara #AW26

STUDIO COLLECTION AW26
Wonderland

Zara Studio reduces canonical pieces to clear, almost archetypal forms: cardigans, sweaters, jackets, striped roll-necks, cropped trousers, dresses and utilitarian outerwear. Rounded shapes, compact jackets and uncomplicated proportions give the collection a subtly nostalgic, pared-back modernism.

Photographer & Director: Ned Rogers  @nedrogers
Styling: #KarlTempler
Hair & Make Up: Sarah Edenborough @sarahedenborough
Set designer: Andy Hillman @andyhillmanstudio
Casting: @unit_c

#zarastudio #zara #AW26

STUDIO COLLECTION AW26
Les Nonchalants

Layering is central: shirt hems and cuffs extend beyond knitwear and tailoring, waistcoats sit over loose shirts, cardigans fall low on the body and jackets meet fluid, generously cut trousers. Cable knits, brushed textures, washed-looking leather, soft tailoring and striped shirting are mixed freely, while worn-in footwear reinforces the slightly dishevelled character. The effect is considered without feeling overly finished.
